basic_details.job_title: APTRANSCO Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Deputy Tahsildar / Tahsildar Posts
basic_details.short_information: Transmission Corporation of A.P. Limited (APTRANSCO), Vidyut Soudha, Vijayawada, is engaging 4 retired Deputy Tahsildar / Tahsildar on contract basis at Rs.75,000 per month including all allowances, initially for one year (maximum three years). Only retired Government employees who served as Tahsildar or Deputy Tahsildar and retired not more than five years before the notification date can apply. Applications in the prescribed format, in duplicate, must be sent to the Chairman & Managing Director or by email, on or before 17 December 2026 at 05:30 PM.

how_to_apply: Fill in the prescribed format, Annexure-I (Application for Engaging Retired Tahsildar / Deputy Tahsildar on Contract Basis), and prepare it in duplicate.
Attach relevant copies of enclosures as per the check list, and superscribe the post applied for.
Address the application to: The Chairman & Managing Director, 4th Floor, SLDC Building, APTRANSCO, Vidyut Soudha, Vijayawada, Pin code: 520004.
Make sure the application is received on or before 17.12.2026 at 05:30 PM.

Annexure-I asks for details of previous employment, personal details, address details, educational and professional qualifications, service and experience, positions held during the last 10 years, special qualifications and relevant experience, vigilance or disciplinary proceedings in service, last pay drawn and pension particulars, willingness and availability, and a list of enclosures. It ends with a declaration signed by the applicant.
Application in the prescribed proforma as per Annexure-I, submitted in duplicate.
Self-attested copies of certificates/documents in support of date of birth, educational qualifications, nationality and caste, wherever applicable.
Copies of retirement orders, service certificate and other relevant documents establishing experience in the cadre of Tahsildar / Deputy Tahsildar.
Last Pay Drawn Certificate and Pension Payment Order (PPO) as applicable.
A brief statement of relevant experience in land acquisition, land records, revenue administration, Government lands and legal matters, wherever applicable.
A signed declaration of willingness to work on contract basis and discharge the responsibilities specified in the notification and Annexure-II.
Any other relevant documents supporting the qualifications and experience claimed by the applicant.

The Annexure-I list of enclosures also names a Vigilance / Disciplinary Clearance Certificate, wherever applicable, and relevant certificates relating to land acquisition, revenue administration and legal matters.
important_instructions: APTRANSCO will not entertain, under any circumstances, information furnished by the candidate subsequently. Applicants should be careful while writing the application form. If any lapse is detected during scrutiny, the candidature will be rejected even if the candidate comes through the final stage of the engagement process or at a later date. The candidate should not furnish any false, tampered or fabricated information or suppress any material information in the application form. APTRANSCO reserves the right to modify or cancel the notification or the engagement process without assigning any reason. Under the Annexure-I declaration, a candidate who gives unwillingness after the interview but before the appointment is processed, or after the offer of appointment, may be debarred for five (5) years from being considered for a post in any PSU under the administrative control of the Energy Department, Govt. of A.P., other than the one to which the candidate belongs. The declaration also states that the applicant has not been disqualified under relevant sections of the Indian Companies Act, 1956, and is not facing any charge of, nor has ever been convicted for, any act of moral turpitude or economic offence.

rows.details: Transmission Corporation of A.P. Limited (APTRANSCO), a Public Sector Utility
Deputy Tahsildar (Retd.) / Tahsildar (Retd.) on Contract basis
Retired from regular Government service not more than five (5) years prior to the date of this notification
Vijayawada (Head Quarters), Visakhapatnam zone, Vijayawada zone or Kadapa zone, as decided by APTRANSCO
Prescribed format in duplicate, addressed to the Chairman & Managing Director, or by email

content_sections.heading: About APTRANSCO
content_sections.text: According to the notice, APTRANSCO was incorporated under the Indian Companies Act 1956 and is a wholly owned State Government Company. It is presently engaged in Transmission of Power, Grid Operations, Transmission Management, Projects, Technical subjects and similar activities. Its office is at Vidyut Soudha, Vijayawada.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice sets these eligibility conditions for the Deputy Tahsildar (Retd.) / Tahsildar (Retd.) posts: The applicant must be a retired Government employee who has served in the cadre of Tahsildar or Deputy Tahsildar in the Revenue Department of the Government of Andhra Pradesh or any other State Government. The applicant must have retired from regular Government service not more than five (5) years prior to the date of this notification, which is dated 27.11.2026. The applicant must possess good administrative, communication, coordination and drafting skills. Telugu language reading and writing skills are a must. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the assigned duties. Preference will be given to candidates with adequate knowledge and experience in legal matters, land acquisition, land records, forest lands, land survey matters and related statutory procedure. The official notification does not specify a minimum educational qualification; candidates should check the notification for the eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs.75,000/- per month, including all allowances, and is subject to applicable statutory deductions, if any. The engagement is on contract basis, initially for a period of one (1) year, with a maximum of three (3) years. The notice states that the tenure will be extended every year, based on yearly assessment and evaluation of performance by the authorities.

content_sections.heading: APTRANSCO Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The retired Tahsildar / Deputy Tahsildar should coordinate effectively with the Chief Engineer zones/circles authorities for smooth function of GEC and asset coordination till logical conclusion with regard to land issues. Annexure-II lists these duties and responsibilities: Coordinate with the Chief Engineers, Superintending Engineers, Divisional Engineers and other concerned officers of APTRANSCO for identification, verification and resolution of land-related issues. Liaise with the Revenue Department, District Administration, Mandal Revenue Offices and other Government departments in connection with land matters pertaining to APTRANSCO. Examine and assist in resolving issues relating to land ownership, land records, survey numbers, boundaries, classification and possession of lands belonging to or required by APTRANSCO. Coordinate matters relating to forest land, land acquisition, alienation, assignment, transfer and mutation of land in favour of APTRANSCO. Assist in the identification, verification and protection of APTRANSCO assets and Government lands allotted to the Corporation. Examine revenue records, title documents, pattadar records, adangal, 1-B, survey records and other relevant documents and offer appropriate suggestions to the concerned authorities. Coordinate with the concerned Revenue and Registration authorities for obtaining certified copies of records, reports and other statutory documents. Assist in the preparation of proposals, representations, reports and correspondence relating to land matters and other revenue-related issues. Monitor pending land-related cases and coordinate with the concerned field officers for their timely resolution. Maintain proper records of land-related matters, follow-up action taken and status of pending issues. Extend necessary assistance to the concerned APTRANSCO officers in legal proceedings, revenue enquiries and other statutory matters relating to lands and properties of the Corporation. Perform any other duties relating to land administration and asset coordination entrusted by the competent authority of APTRANSCO.

content_sections.heading: Place of Work
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be posted at any of these offices, as decided by APTRANSCO: Head Quarters in APTRANSCO, Vidyut Soudha, Vijayawada; Visakhapatnam zone, APTRANSCO, Visakhapatnam; Vijayawada zone, APTRANSCO, Vijayawada; Kadapa zone, APTRANSCO, Kadapa. The Corporation reserves the right to allocate or change the place of posting depending upon administrative requirements.
